answers.reason: The student holds no office that would give them membership in the university senate.
The budget planning round is part of the university leadership sphere, not open to ordinary students.
Appointment committees select professors and do not include ordinary students without a specific mandate.
The student holds no office and is not listed as a member of the faculty council.
The description does not grant ordinary students membership in the study commission.
The examination board decides on individual student matters and does not include the student as a decision-maker.
The internal research funding round is for research projects and does not include ordinary students.
Module revision is not assigned to ordinary students in the organizational description.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled within the faculty without ordinary student membership.
Orientation week planning is for new students' programmes, but the description does not grant ordinary students a seat on this specific planning body.
